      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mempool label and edits src/txmempool.cpp to prevent FeeFrac integer overflows during cluster mempool linearization.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Clamping transaction fee deltas resolves a signed integer overflow in FeeFrac during cluster mempool linearization. The PR description notes a reproducible UBSan failure (\"feefrac.h:108:13: runtime error: signed integer overflow\") and cluster calculation corruption, which is an important correctness fix for cluster mempool data structures."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies prioritisetransaction handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp and tests in test/functional/mining_prioritisetransaction.py to fix getblocktemplate transaction omission.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Bounding prioritisetransaction deltas prevents template construction from omitting prioritized transactions due to corrupted chunk fees. The PR shows extreme fee deltas caused getblocktemplate to omit affected transactions, though triggering the issue requires unrealistic deltas exceeding MAX_MONEY."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mining.cpp only to validate domain parameters for mempool prioritisation, not the RPC framework.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change alters domain-specific validation inside prioritisetransaction rather than the RPC infrastructure or dispatch layer."
    }
